title: Parvati Devachi Ganpati (Parvati Hill Ganpati)
text:
Parvati Devachi Ganpati (Parvati Hill Ganpati) (पार्वती देवाची गणपती) — Heritage Temple (Peshwa era), located in Parvati Hill, Pune, established 18th century (Peshwa era).

History: The Parvati Hill temple complex, built by Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao (Nana Saheb) in the 18th century, sits atop a hillock 2,100 feet above sea level and includes temples of Parvati, Devdeveshwar, Vishnu, Kartikeya, and a Ganesh shrine. Devotees climb 103 steps for a 360-degree panoramic view of Pune, including Shaniwar Wada, Sinhagad Fort and Pune University. A small pre-Peshwa Buddhist cave lies halfway up the hill.

Idol/Deity: Traditional Ganesh idol within the Parvati temple complex; the hilltop setting with sweeping views is the draw.

Temple/Mandir address: Parvati Hill, Parvati Gaon, Pune 411009 (103 steps from base). Festival pandal address: TO UPDATE — darshan at the permanent temple; confirm any special pandal for 2026. Maps link: TO UPDATE — August 2026. Coordinates: 18.4972, 73.8467.

Aarti timings — Morning: 6:00 AM; Evening: 8:00 PM.

Special events during the 10 days: Sunrise darshan on Chaturthi morning draws huge crowds; photography spots for city views.
